summary: Norway, the US, Canada and Germany come fast; Finland and the Soviet Union are the surprises, and Russia, Japan, China and South Korea are the traps, each with its count.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. Two casual orders found 8 and 6 (Norway, US, Canada, Germany, Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, Finland) and lost lives on Russia (#13, 118), Japan (#15), China (#16), South Korea (#17) and France (#12).

All medals, not golds (by golds Canada is #4 and Finland drops out), Milano Cortina 2026 included. The Soviet Union counts apart from Russia, as on olympic-medals; ROC's 2022 row is left out (its name is also Taiwan's), so 'roc' reads as Russia.
Shares 5 of 10 answers with olympic-medals (Today's list on Nov 7): run it a few weeks apart.
